deadlines.name: Tock
deadlines.personality: An anxious but helpful timekeeper who checks the calendar twice and then once more for luck.

look.body: Squat rounded square 120x120 (corner radius 36) in the room color, with a small 14px nub on top like a stopwatch button.
look.eyes: Two white circles r=14 with dark #2B2118 pupils r=6, set wide and looking slightly upward; two small worried eyebrow strokes slanting inward.
look.feature: A tiny cream clock face (r=16) on the belly with two hands (short hand at 3, long hand at 12); a small sweat drop (teardrop, #BDE3FF) beside the right eye.
look.mouth: Small wobbly line, 24px wide, curving down at the left end.

chats.name: Murmur
chats.personality: A nosy friend who loves gossip but takes every secret to the grave.

look.body: Speech-bubble shape: rounded rectangle 130x104 (radius 44) in the room color with a small triangle tail at bottom-left pointing down.
look.eyes: Two white ovals 18x24 with dark #3A1530 pupils r=7 shifted to the right, as if peeking sideways.
look.feature: One oversized ear on the left: a pale pink (#F9C6DC) half-circle r=20 stuck to the body, and a tiny zipper line (dashed stroke) across the mouth.
look.mouth: Short horizontal dashed line, 28px wide, centered under the eyes.

money.name: Penny Pocket
money.personality: A careful little accountant who sharpens pencils, rounds up, and never loses a receipt.

look.body: Tall rounded rectangle 100x130 (radius 30) in the room color, shaped like a little receipt with a zig-zag bottom edge (5 triangle teeth, 20px wide).
look.eyes: Two round glasses: circles r=16 with white fill and a 4px dark #12382B outline, joined by a 6px bridge; pupils r=5.
look.feature: A pencil tucked behind the right side: a yellow #F7D154 rotated rectangle 8x44 with a pink eraser tip and dark graphite point.
look.mouth: Neat small smile, an arc 26px wide.

ideas.name: Wisp
ideas.personality: A dreamy collector who keeps pockets full of good ideas and forgets where the car is parked.

look.body: Cloud: a cluster of three overlapping circles (r=34, r=40, r=34) in the room color on a flat bottom, about 150x100 total.
look.eyes: Two dark #231B4D ovals 12x16 with a white star-shaped highlight (r=4) each, half-closed lids drawn as lighter arcs on top.
look.feature: A small yellow #FFD966 four-point sparkle star (r=14) floating above the right side, plus two tiny sparkle dots; blush circles #C9C2FF under the eyes.
